name: Screenpipe
description: Records your screen and audio 24/7 locally, then serves that history as searchable context to Claude, Codex and other coding agents so they know what you have seen and done.

skills.name: Continuous Screen Capture
skills.description: Records screen and microphone continuously on-device, storing frames and transcripts locally without sending data to a server.

skills.name: Searchable History
skills.description: Queries months of captured screen and audio history by text, app or time window to retrieve the moment you need.

skills.name: Agent Context Feed
skills.description: Feeds recorded activity into Claude, Codex and other agents as grounding context so they can act on what you actually did.
